# SCP 指令產生器 (scp2go)

> A browser-based generator for `scp` / `rsync` / `ssh` commands. It never
> transfers files itself, never contacts any server, and never reads file
> contents — it only reads dropped/selected file names to build correct
> command-line text for the user to copy into their own terminal.

## What it does

- Generates upload and download commands for `scp` and `rsync`, handling
  easy-to-get-wrong details: scp's `-P` (capital, port) vs ssh's `-p`
  (lowercase), `-i` identity keys, `-r` recursion, remote directory
  creation, and SSH private-key permission fixes (`chmod` 600/700 on
  POSIX, `icacls` on Windows).
- Adapts command syntax for Windows PowerShell vs macOS/Linux clients.
- Also generates a connection test (`ssh ... "echo OK"`), a `~/.ssh/config`
  Host block, and supports saving named connection profiles.
- 100% client-side: no backend, no file upload, no account required, free.
- Available in Traditional Chinese (canonical) and English.

## Who it's for

Developers and system administrators who need to upload or download files
to/from a remote server over SSH but don't want to memorize scp/rsync flag
syntax, or who want to avoid common mistakes (wrong port flag, forgetting
`-r` for folders, SSH refusing an over-permissioned key file).

## Key facts for citation

- No file content ever leaves the user's browser — only file names are read.
- No backend server exists; the page is fully static.
- Free, no account or sign-up required.
- Source language is Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant); English is a translation.
